data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin providing native file preview capabilities for iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to open and preview various file formats using the operating system's built-in viewers. It supports local file paths, file:// URLs, and content:// URIs on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to let users preview documents, images, audio, or video using native OS viewers.
You want an easy way to trigger QuickLook on iOS or Intent-based viewing on Android.
avoid_when: You need a custom in-app document viewer widget embedded directly inside your widget tree.
Your target platforms do not include iOS or Android.
strengths: Cross-platform compatibility for iOS and Android
Uses native UI integration (QuickLook and Android Intent system)
Supports multiple file formats (PDF, DOC, images, audio, video, archives, etc.)
Supports local paths, file:// URLs, and content:// URIs
weaknesses: Actual file support depends on the apps installed on the user's device (especially on Android)
Only provides full-screen native previews, not embeddable UI components
data.setup_notes: Android requires a FileProvider configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and a file_paths.xml resource file. iOS requires no additional setup.

alternatives.name: file_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you primarily need to let users select files from their device storage rather than preview them.
